title: Circuit V1 Engine for my Roblox Karting game
author: Layser_
selftext:
Hey guys,  
Showing up my engine for creating circuits. The idea is that given a drawing done by me (in paint), I have a custom engine that allows an LLM to describe the circuit as JSON. The engine then uses that JSON and generates the Roblox scene, it supports height differences, different road widths, glider jumps, turbos, minimap SVG-like, coins, item boxes, and more.

Game is much more advanced now and I will be posting up more updates if there's some interest. You can also follow the development on "@bloxracersgame" tiktok/instagram.

\- Jorge
